simulator.note: Boots as an M3602B board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_x402p_403p_galaxy_1553_app_starts.py, run_dump_x402p_403p_galaxy_1553_capture_screen.py): the "M3602B 1.1.6" bootloader communicates with the external Lemontree front-panel and EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged SCL = GPIO 62 / SDA = GPIO 171 using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames (updating the 4-digit 7-segment display " ON " -> "    " -> " on "), prints "APP  init ok", unpacks maincode(AV) (7.36 MB) to 0x80008000, and starts the single-CPU application.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB1, initialises hs_config_init over SPI, and renders its Synaps Galaxy PS OSD dialog through GeM3602.

desc: Opticum HD X402p / X403p (System ID 06020200) firmware 1.5.53 with the Synaps Galaxy PS GUI and TNT fix by dreamer1983 (2014-05-11) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602B Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.

Uses the external Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit 7-segment front-panel microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 (CRC-16/XMODEM protocol), an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and an Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
